shots.visual: Sweat dripping down his face, hand trembling while gripping a small black detonator with a glowing red light.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 這是你們逼我的！都去死吧！

shots.visual: Standing calmly amidst the chaos, eyes cold and sharp, looking directly at the villain.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪，你已經沒有退路了。

shots.visual: SWAT team members smashing through the high windows, glass shards flying everywhere.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 警方破門而入，包圍網正式收攏。

shots.visual: Eyes wide with madness, thumb hovering over the red button.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 別過來！再過來我就按下去！

shots.visual: Holding a tablet, tracking the signal from the detonator, face tense.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 陳總，那是神經毒氣裝置，不能硬來！

shots.visual: Screaming hysterically, pressing the button with a violent thumb movement.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 下地獄去吧！

shots.visual: Throwing a chair towards the gas canister to deflect the initial blast direction.
Thick green smoke erupts from a hidden vent, obscuring everyone's vision instantly.
Coughing violently, her expensive jewelry clinking as she falls to her knees in panic.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 救命……哥哥救我……

shots.visual: Sprinting toward a hidden bookshelf door, gas mask already halfway on his face.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 誰也別想抓到我！

shots.visual: Covering his nose with a wet cloth, eyes scanning the smoke for the escaping target.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 林素，封鎖所有出口！

shots.visual: Tapping rapidly on the tablet, light from the screen reflecting in her focused eyes.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 他進了緊急逃生通道，通往頂樓！

shots.visual: Running up a spiral staircase, gasping for air, the sound of boots echoing behind him.
Kicking open the heavy metal door to the rooftop staircase, determination in every move.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你逃不掉的。

shots.visual: Looking down from the height, the city lights blurred below, wind whipping his hair.
A cruel, desperate smile forming on his lips as he looks at a second, larger remote.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 既然我毀了，這座城市也別想好過。

shots.visual: Stepping onto the rooftop, the wind howling, moonlight highlighting his stern face.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 收手吧，趙天豪。

shots.visual: The two men facing each other on the edge of the skyscraper, the sky dark and heavy.
Holding the remote high, backing away toward the very edge of the building.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 收手？五年前你家破人亡時，怎麼不叫我收手？

shots.visual: Eyes narrowing, voice dropping to a dangerous whisper.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 那是你欠陳家的血債。

shots.visual: Laughing maniacally, spit flying from his mouth.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 成王敗寇！我輸了，也要拉百萬人墊背！

shots.visual: Emerging from the shadows behind Chen Feng, gun drawn but hesitant due to the remote.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 放下遙控器，那是全城的供水系統開關！

shots.visual: Finger resting on the final execution button, eyes bloodshot.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 明天早上，全城的水都會變成劇毒！

shots.visual: Taking a slow, calculated step forward, hands raised slightly to distract.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你真的以為，你的毒氣還能運作嗎？

shots.visual: Expression flickers from confidence to sudden doubt.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 你什麼意思？少在那裡虛張聲勢！

shots.visual: A small smirk playing on her lips as she checks her tablet.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 信號攔截器已經啟動，你手裡的只是廢鐵。

shots.visual: Pressing the button repeatedly in a frenzy. Nothing happens.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 不可能！這不可能！給我爆啊！

shots.visual: Suddenly rushing forward like a predator, closing the distance in a blur.
Looking up in terror as Chen Feng's shadow looms over him.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 別過來！哇啊！

shots.visual: Chen Feng grabbing Zhao's wrist and twisting it with a sickening crack.
Screaming in agony, the remote falling from his hand and sliding toward the edge.
Staring down at the pathetic man, his foot pressing on Zhao's chest.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 這只是利息，正餐還在後面。

shots.visual: Gasping, his body half-hanging off the rooftop ledge, looking down at the abyss.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳峰……你殺了我吧……

shots.visual: A cold, emotionless stare. He picks up the remote, which suddenly starts beeping fast.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 殺你？太便宜你了。

shots.visual: The remote beeps turn into a solid tone. Zhao Tianhao's eyes bug out as he realizes the 'fail-safe' is actually a self-destruct for the rooftop.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 不，這不是毒氣遙控，這是……炸彈！
